name: Airbnb-Processing-Daily-Booking-Calendars
what_it_holds: Companion repo to the UBDC PLOS ONE paper: a 5-step Python pipeline (stp1-stp5) that turns consecutive daily Airbnb calendar scrapes into booking/cancellation events, focused on 'cancellation trend in Edinburgh during first lockdown'; includes a committed AggregatedFigures.xlsx with the paper's summary statistics.
why_useful: A concrete, working method for converting raw calendar snapshots into occupancy AND cancellation-rate time series — usable on our own Inside Airbnb calendar vintages to build a non-review-based occupancy estimator, and directly on-topic for the RNPL/cancellation thesis (gap #3).
themes: Airbnb calendar / availability / blocked-night datasets and occupancy-estimation code (San Francisco model, review-to-booking ratios)

name: opensky-api
what_it_holds: Official Python/Java client for the OpenSky Network REST API: pulls current and historical ADS-B state vectors (aircraft position, altitude, velocity, callsign) and, via the OpenSky historical database (separate access tier), full flight tracks and airport arrival/departure counts back to ~2019. GPL-3.0, actively maintained (OAuth2 support added March 2026, 175 commits).
why_useful: The standard client for live OpenSky queries; only useful in combination with the historical Impala/Trino access (see xoolive/traffic) or the pre-built COVID-19 CSV dumps for anything backward-looking, since the live API alone gives only current snapshots.
themes: Flight tracking and schedules: OpenSky, ADS-B Exchange, FlightRadar scrapers, aviationstack samples, airline seat capacity by route
